phinite_api_key.title: Phinite API Key
phinite_api_key.description: Your Phinite API key (JWT starting with eyJ...) from the Phinite dashboard → API Keys. Your workspace and organization are read from the key automatically — this is the only value you need to enter. Stored securely in your system keychain.
